label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 51
title: Operator UI: issue/revoke/extend license keys
body:
## Original (as captured)
UI to generate, view, copy, revoke, extend and re-key licenses; show validation status.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0061)
Generate signed license keys (core/signing.py) embedding tier + seats + quotas + expiry + trial; validate on activation and periodically; support rotation, revocation and offline validation for self-hosted.
